name: sapb1-assistant
description: SAP Business One (B1) ERP assistant: object type number, table and primary key lookup from a bundled list of all B1 object types, verified SQL views/queries from bundled B1 10.0 and 9.3 data dictionaries, C# development against the DI API from a bundled DI API 10.0 class and enum reference, and Service Layer (REST / OData v4) integration guidance including SQLQueries and FP 2602 webhooks. More capabilities to follow.
